theorem: The unital Borel/continuous functional calculus generated by one self-adjoint A is commutative, so every layer L=f(A) commutes with A and all products depend only on the joint scalar spectral multipliers. For the strict Z12 distance operator, every deterministic real symmetric matrix invariant under the same translations and reflection is a distance-circulant in the seven-dimensional association algebra and therefore also commutes with A. The tested intrinsic diagonal saliency constructions are scalar because all vertices have the same strict orbit data. Consequently no genuinely noncommuting layer is generated in this declared single-object equivariant class.
